messages:
Ethan (Docs): Quick sync: finalizing v1->v2 deprecation copy today. Need legal sign-off + i18n extraction before we deploy banner.
Maya (Legal): Send the exact English phrasing we plan to publish. I need to confirm the deprecation timeline sentence. Use token {DEPRECATION_DATE}.
Sora (i18n): I'll extract strings once you push a strings.json. Please mark code blocks with `code_` prefix so we don't translate identifiers.
Ravi (SDK): SDK snippets will be normalized to ISO timestamps and include `// DO_NOT_TRANSLATE` header in code blocks. We'll avoid MM/DD/YYYY.
Ana (Localization): We'll do DE/FR first. Please include short context notes for ambiguous phrases. Add `short_banner`+`long_banner` keys.
Ethan (Docs): Plan: open PR with /content/deprecations/v1_to_v2/strings.json, include context notes. Tag legal and i18n in PR.
Maya (Legal): Reviewed the draft; one edit: change "will be turned off" to "will be retired". Also confirm `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` is accurate.
Sora (i18n): Running a quick regex sweep for MM/DD/YYYY to be safe. If found, fail CI.
Ravi (SDK): Companion PR for snippet changes will reference the docs PR. Adding tests to ensure parity across JS/Python examples.
Ana (Localization): ETA: DE/FR in 3 business days after merge. We'll keep placeholders intact.
Ethan (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310 (placeholder). Please review.
Maya (Legal): Reviewed and approved the English copy. You can proceed to merge.
Sora (i18n): CI checks green. No MM/DD/YYYY found.
Ravi (SDK): Snippet PR merged. Docs team, ping when deploy is scheduled so we can coordinate SDK notes.
Ethan (Docs): Scheduling deploy tomorrow 9am PT. Will post final confirmation here before publish.
